title: JA Kinetic wp7 1.1.6: sticky header, dimmed drawer backdrop, newsletter focus ring, back-to-top mark and the other measured differences from the source are gone on every page
steps: S1: A WordPress site running the wp-ja-kinetic theme under test (local stand restored from the quickstart pack) and the Joomla source (local stand from the released source quickstart, web fonts loading).

S2: From the TCH checkout run: node vendor/wordpress/tracy-wordpress-theme/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme/scripts/visual/site-sweep.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --run-root tasks/ja-kinetic-wp7 --spec tasks/ja-kinetic-wp7/spec --zip <theme.zip> --out <dir> (all ten checks; about 6 minutes).
S3: From the TCH checkout run: node tasks/ja-kinetic-wp7/tools/measure115.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --out <dir> (the 1.1.5 regression group, 9 checks).
S4: Read each check line of both runs and the final lines.
expect: site-sweep: fix-measure.json written, 10/10 checks pass (overflow, scheme, background, header, chips, fixed-widgets, icons, forms, text, first-interaction), 0 defects on 30 routes at 320, 390, 768, 1024, 1180 and 1440px in light and dark; the only not-measured cause is touch-control-not-found (2 cases), recorded in review.config.json sweep.accept with a hand measurement.

The header bar stays fixed at the top on scroll; the open drawer dims the page behind it; the newsletter field shows the source's outline and ring on focus; the back-to-top mark has the source's size; the header band colour in dark on the Blueprint and Signal homes equals the source's.
measure115: 9/9 checks pass (author, features, overflow, mega, tablet, footer, eyebrow, comments, timeline404).

The Contact page of the demo (no tracy_site_identity / tracy_contact_to) shows no mailbox and its form answers 'An error occurred while sending the email.' (decision D-59); the sweep reports no group for it.
evidence: Sweeps of 05/10/2026 against the local Joomla source: baseline (1.0.3 pack + theme 1.1.5) 6/10 checks pass; final on the restored 1.0.4 pack with theme 1.1.6 including the Contact change merged from develop (sha256 b603b4f0) 10/10 pass, 0 defects (tasks/ja-kinetic-wp7/release/fix-measure.json)
fence: Browser-measured behaviour of the shipped theme against the source; the sweep fails closed on a crash or a deadline
